# DividerInset

`Flare.Components.DividerInset`

Inset style of a FlareDivider.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | Full-bleed divider spanning the full width (the default). |
| `Inset` | `1` | Indented from the leading edge only. |
| `MiddleInset` | `2` | Indented from both edges. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDivider`
